delivery.outcome: Make Git work durable across memory and process boundaries without turning checkpoints into Git authority.
nonGoals: Do not embed source diffs, stash contents, local paths or credentials in lifecycle documents
Do not restore or overwrite a divergent workspace automatically
Do not implement the external snapshot service in wellmanifest

architecture.decision: Add a no-ref-movement checkpoint transition whose receipt binds an external continuity document; safe work content remains in an authorized commit or protected snapshot.
dataChanges: Checkpoint receipt binds exact HEAD and one continuity receipt
architecture.rollback: Revert checkpoint schema, grammar, Lifecycle projection, conformance and documentation together.

validation.evidence: Positive clean checkpoint plus adversarial state-move, push, publication and duplicate-ref cases.
